question: If cosec⁴ θ = 49 + cot⁴ θ, Then find the value of sin θ.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the identity **a⁴ − b⁴ = (a² − b²)(a² + b²)**.

Given **cosec⁴ θ − cot⁴ θ = 49**.

As **cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1**, we get **1 × (cosec² θ + cot² θ) = 49**.

Adding **cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1** to **cosec² θ + cot² θ = 49** gives **2 cosec² θ = 50**.

Therefore, **cosec θ = 5** ⇒ **sin θ = 1/5**.

**∴ The correct answer is 1/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **cosec⁴ θ = 49 + cot⁴ θ**

**Formula Used:** **cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1** and **sin θ = 1/cosec θ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fc3bc5b67d980161bc987f1d33cf7414e3bd01f65596557be4573caffc48929.png] 

⇒ **cosec⁴ θ − cot⁴ θ = 49**

⇒ (**cosec² θ − cot² θ**)(**cosec² θ + cot² θ**) = 49

⇒ 1 × (**cosec² θ + cot² θ**) = 49

⇒ **cosec² θ + (cosec² θ − 1)** = 49

⇒ **2 cosec² θ − 1 = 49**

⇒ **2 cosec² θ = 50**

⇒ **cosec² θ = 25**

⇒ **cosec θ = 5**

⇒ **sin θ = 1/5**

**∴ The correct answer is 1/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Trigonometric Identities

1 + **cot² θ** = **cosec² θ**, which can be rearranged as **cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1**.

Algebraic Difference of Squares

The expression **x⁴ − y⁴** can always be factored as (**x² − y²**)(**x² + y²**).

Reciprocal Relations

**sin θ** = 1/**cosec θ**, **cos θ** = 1/**sec θ**, and **tan θ** = 1/**cot θ**.</p
